candidates.name: Sarcoidosis
support_spans: Multiple dull red tender nodules on the forehead, left cheek, and sternum
Solitary 1 × 1 cm firm right cervical lymph node
Liver palpable 4 cm below the right costal margin
Cervical lymph node biopsy: Large areas of necrosis rimmed by epithelioid cell granulomas with occasional Langhans' multinucleated giant cells
candidates.why: The presence of granulomatous inflammation, epithelioid cell granulomas, and Langhans' multinucleated giant cells are characteristic of sarcoidosis.

candidates.name: Tuberculosis
